status.description: BLOCKED = ticket-level block (RFC § 1.2/VERIFY debug cap), distinct from session-level STATE.phase: BLOCKED

blocker.description: Facts + dead ends, set when status is BLOCKED

review_passes.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field; phases/review.md uses it to enforce its two-pass cap mechanically rather than from memory. Absent from this schema until v7.101.0.

verify_attempts.description: RFC 1.2 recognized optional ticket field; absent reads as zero. Counts the failed fix cycles phases/verify.md spends on this ticket, so its cap is mechanical rather than remembered -- the same argument review_passes already carries one phase over. The cap number itself lives in phases/verify.md and is read from there, never copied.
